findings.title: Early exits lose settled results before context batching commits
findings.fix: Retain settled observations on every exit path, committing partial batches exactly once before cleanup. Cover iterator closure and later fail-fast errors with original call/result ordering and no action replay.

findings.title: Receipt-only authentic delivery removes failed-result protection
findings.fix: Track acknowledged result presence in private delivery provenance; a receipt-only record must not release raw-result protection. Preserve optional outcome, redacted/null observations, receipt diagnostics and legacy inputs.

findings.title: Recovery between checkpoint and restore creates duplicate final results
findings.fix: Reconcile folded pending observations by original invocation/protocol identity across receipt transitions, preserving unrelated pending input, namespace separation and one final result.
